To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a smart tourist destination is a place that, in order to improve the quality of life of its residents and visitors, is able to provide the necessary services and infrastructures to meet the needs and demands of the tourist market, in an intelligent way and through the use of ICT, in an integrated and coordinated manner, in order to achieve the objectives established in the strategic plan.

“a Smart Tourist Destination is a tourist destination that, by means of the application of information and communication technology, provides a set of services that improve the tourist experience of the visitor, and the competitiveness of the tourism sector in the destination”.

a smart tourist destination is a place that, in order to be sustainable in the long term, is able to provide a high quality tourism experience to its visitors, while it is able to improve the well-being and quality of life of its inhabitants, by means of a management entity that is able to coordinate and integrate a wide range of services and technologies that are able to respond to the needs of the tourists, the inhabitants and the local environment, and that are able to improve their quality of life.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of the main characteristics of a STD, which are considered to be the basis for a more comprehensive study.
the identification of the most important aspects of a Smart Tourist Destination and the way in which they are related.
a conceptualization of STD that is not only based on a combination of technologies but also on a combination of services and technologies.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

a STD is a tourist destination that, through the implementation of an integrated and sustainable strategy of development, based on the exploitation of the potential of its resources, is able to provide a set of products and services of quality, in order to meet the needs and expectations of the market, and to achieve a competitive advantage in the tourist sector, through the implementation and management of an innovative model of development, which is able to generate a high level of satisfaction for the users and a high value for its stakeholders.

a Smart Tourist Destination is a destination with an innovative and sustainable management that provides an experience of high value, in which the visitor is a protagonist, and that uses the information and communication technologies (ICT) as a means to improve its competitiveness.

a Smart Tourist Destination is an entity that has the potential to provide a high level of satisfaction to its visitors, while at the same time it is a place that can provide a good quality of life to its residents, with the aim of creating a virtuous circle of mutual benefit between the destination and its stakeholders.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
it is necessary to go beyond the technological dimension of the concept of smartness and to include the socio-economic dimension in the definition of a STD.

the concept of STD has a very broad spectrum of meanings and, in general, the concept of “smart” has a wide variety of interpretations, which makes it difficult to define a common profile for the concept of STD.

a STD is a destination that has a high level of development in the areas of ICT and that is able to provide an experience of excellence for tourists, through the use of technology, and in which all actors are committed to the sustainable development of the destination.
The main takeaway from our work is that

a Smart Tourist Destination is a complex system with multiple dimensions and functions, in which the main goal is to achieve an improvement of the quality of the tourist experience, through a set of technological, social and economic innovations, which are supported by a strong management structure, and which are aimed to improve the competitiveness of the destination.

a STD is not only a tourist destination with an advanced ICT infrastructure, but it is also a destination that has the ability to manage its own resources in a smart way, to provide services to its visitors and residents, and to improve the quality of life of its inhabitants.
a STD is not only an innovative destination, but also a sustainable destination.
